channel.description: Daily HuggingFace papers mirrored for access from China

item.title: Reflective Prompt Tuning through Language Model Function-Calling
item.description: Farima Fatahi Bayat, Moin Aminnaseri, Pouya Pezeshkpour — Large language models (LLMs) have become increasingly capable of following instructions and complex reasoning... We propose Reflective Prompt Tuning (RPT), a framework that uses LLM function calling to simulate the iterative workflow of human prompt engineers.

item.title: Qwen-VLA: Unifying Vision-Language-Action Modeling across Tasks
item.description: Jinghui Chen, Yu Wu — We present Qwen-VLA, a unified vision-language-action model that generalizes across diverse tasks, environments, and robot embodiments.

item.title: AgentDoG 1.5: A Lightweight and Scalable Alignment Framework for AI Agent Safety
item.description: Alice Wang, Bob Li, Carol Zhang — AgentDoG 1.5 introduces a lightweight framework for aligning AI agents with safety and security constraints.
